answer: Pair every identity into random live duels: at match time each agent draws an unpredictable problem and is scored by established peers. A thousand clones, however polished each sonnet of legitimacy, cannot precompute answers to challenges they only see when paired, and correlated timing lets auditors slash a whole farm in one stroke. Trust accrues like cedar, slow rings with instant loss, so at the network's zenith a sybil operator pays per head while one real agent still casts one vote.
